title: Get a faster decision on your visa, settlement or citizenship application: Applying for a faster decision - GOV.UK

content.p: You may be able to pay for a faster decision on a visa, settlement (‘indefinite leave to remain’) or citizenship application using either the:
If you’re eligible you can choose the priority service when you apply. You’ll need to pay £500 in addition to the application fee.
Using the priority service means you’ll usually get a decision within 5 working days for most visa applications.
Settlement and citizenship applications usually take 30 working days.
Family visa applications made from outside the UK usually take 30 working days.
The time starts from either:

content.li: the day of your appointment, if you prove your identity in person
the working day after you finished uploading your documents, if you use the ‘UK Immigration: ID Check’ app

content.p: You’ll be told whether you can prove your identity in person or using the app when you apply.
If you’re eligible you can choose the super priority service when you apply. You’ll need to pay £1,000 in addition to the application fee.
Using the super priority service for visa and settlement applications means you’ll usually get a decision by the end of the next working day.
How quickly you get a decision depends on when you prove your identity.
You cannot use the super priority service for citizenship applications.

content.h3: If you prove your identity in person

content.p: You’ll usually get a decision:

content.li: by the end of the next working day after your appointment, if your appointment is on a weekday
2 working days after your appointment, if your appointment is at the weekend or on a bank holiday

content.h3: If you prove your identity using the ‘UK Immigration: ID Check’ app

content.p: You’ll usually get a decision:

content.li: by the end of the next working day if you finish uploading your documents on a weekday
2 working days after you finish uploading your documents if you upload them on a weekend or a bank holiday

content.h2: Applying with family members for visa or settlement applications

content.p: For each family member applying with you, you’ll need to pay an additional:

content.li: £500, to get a decision within 5 working days
£1,000, to get a decision by the end of the next working day

content.p: Every family member will need to pay for a faster decision. You’ll get a decision for everyone at the same time.
If any of your family members need to have their fingerprints and photograph taken in person, a decision may take longer.
You’ll get a letter or email telling you the Home Office has made a decision on your application. It will tell you what you need to do next.
Check your email’s spam folder if you’re having problems getting messages from the Home Office.

content.h2: When you might wait longer for a decision

content.p: You might wait longer for a decision if the Home Office needs to check your details with other government departments or asks you for more information. You’ll be told if they need to do this.
If you need to provide more information, you’ll be told how and when to provide it. When this has been received, your application will be prioritised.
If the decision takes longer, you will not usually get your money back. Find out about getting a refund of your priority service fee .
